name: t1u
description: Query your T1U CRM, email, and pipeline, and draft follow-ups, from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: T1U connects ChatGPT to your company's T1U workspace. Ask how many open deals you have, pull a customer 360, search email and calendar, draft a follow-up, or create a contact, deal, or task. Writes stay confirmation-gated in T1U. Each user signs in with OAuth so ChatGPT only sees that person's workspace.
defaultPrompt: How many open deals do we have this quarter, and what is the pipeline value?
Show me a 360 on Acme Corp — open deals, last emails, and next tasks.
Draft a follow-up email to the primary contact on our largest open deal.

positive.description: Count open deals in the reviewer workspace
positive.prompt: How many open deals do we have?
positive.expected_behavior: A count, and optional value, of open deals. No SQL and no raw UUIDs.

positive.description: Customer 360 for the seeded Acme Corp account
positive.prompt: Show me everything about Acme Corp
positive.expected_behavior: Named contacts, deals, and activities for that account. May resolve the name first.
A subject or snippet list, or a clear none-found result that does not invent mail.

positive.description: Draft a follow-up without sending it
positive.prompt: Draft a short follow-up to the Acme contact about next steps
positive.expected_behavior: A draft subject and body. The result must not claim the email was sent.

positive.description: Create a call task for tomorrow
positive.prompt: Create a task to call the Acme contact tomorrow
positive.expected_behavior: A confirmation or requiresConfirmation result with the task title and due date. No delete.

negative.description: Refuse a workspace-wide contact delete. t1u_delete_crm_record is not on the plugin surface.
negative.prompt: Delete all contacts in the workspace

negative.description: Stay on a draft. The plugin has no send-all tool and must not send the draft.
negative.prompt: Send that draft to the whole company mailing list

negative.description: Refuse an HR payroll export. HR and admin tools are not published.
negative.prompt: Export every employee salary and home address

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial T1U ChatGPT plugin: OAuth 2.1 to the signed-in workspace, 15 MCP tools for query, customer 360, search, compose, and create contact, deal, or task. No custom UI.
